text:
The sound from the courtyard is the core of it. I hear it in my head several times a week, sometimes several times a day, even now, two and a half years later. It comes when something heavy falls, when someone drops a bag, sometimes for no reason at all. When it comes I see M on the cobblestones and feel my hand on his jacket.

I developed an intense fear of heights and of balconies. I can't stand near a window on an upper floor. In the hospital, where I now work as a junior doctor, I avoid the windows in the higher wards. When I see someone sitting on a wall or a railing I have to look away and my heart races.

The doubt about whether I pushed him is the worst part. Rationally, I know I didn't. M doesn't blame me. The police closed the case. But the feeling that my hand might have pushed rather than grabbed comes back again and again. It's like a splinter.

The guilt about not helping properly is also huge. I was supposed to be the one who knew first aid. During my emergency medicine rotation, the first time I had to assist with a trauma patient who had fallen, I froze and had to leave the room. My supervisor was kind but I was humiliated.

I had nightmares nearly every night in the first year. Moons, balconies, falling. Sometimes I'm the one falling. I'd wake up with my hand reaching out.

I became depressed. I thought about quitting medical school. I felt like a fraud, how could I be a doctor if I froze when it mattered? I withdrew from most of the friends who were at the party, because being with them brought it back. I drank a lot in the first months.

I also had periods of feeling unreal, like I was watching my life from the outside, mostly in the weeks after. That faded.

Ich habe seitdem Angst vor Dunkelheit und vor Stromausfällen, ich habe immer eine Taschenlampe dabei. Allein im Wald fühle ich mich unwohl, vor allem abends. Ich hatte ein paar Monate lang Albträume von Gestalten an der Wand.
Felt embarrassed for a while, avoided video calls. That's it.
I became very anxious about insects and especially about my feet. I couldn't walk barefoot anywhere for a year, even at home. At night I'd check my bed. I had nightmares about scorpions.

Die Trennung war ohnehin schwer, aber dass sie während des Trips passiert ist, hat alles schlimmer gemacht. Ich hatte monatelang Flashbacks an diesen Abend, an seine Stimme und an die Wände, die auf mich zukommen. Ich bin in eine Depression gefallen und konnte kaum schlafen. Ich hatte das Gefühl, dass ich nicht liebenswert bin und dass alle mich irgendwann verlassen.

I fell into a deep depression. The trip made me believe the voice that says I'm worthless, and it took a long time for that belief to loosen. I had flashbacks to the school toilets, more vivid than before the trip. I couldn't use public toilets for months, and the smell of bleach would make me shake. I started hitting myself again occasionally when I was upset, which I hadn't done in years. I felt betrayed by the influencer and stupid for believing him. I also became very isolated because I felt ashamed of what happened.

Since that party I've had depersonalisation that comes and goes. In the first few months it was constant, I felt like I was operating my body from somewhere far away, like a drone pilot. My limbs often felt like they didn't belong to me. I'd look at my hand and feel it was a stranger's hand.

Now it comes in episodes, usually when I'm tired, stressed, or in bright busy places like supermarkets. During an episode everything goes flat and dreamlike, and I panic because I'm afraid I'll get stuck there.

I've also had a lot of anxiety about my health. Every tingling or numbness in my hands or feet makes me think I'm getting paralysed. I had nerve conduction tests which were normal.

My mood went down a lot, especially in the first year. I felt like I'd broken something in myself and that nobody could fix it. I'm a dancer and the DP affected my dancing, I couldn't feel my body properly.
I was afraid of hospitals for a long time and didn't go to the doctor for an actual infection the next year because of it. I was also angry and felt humiliated. Some panic when my heart beat fast.

Seit diesem Abend kommen die Erinnerungen an meine Kindheit viel häufiger und intensiver als früher. Ich hatte Flashbacks, vor allem wenn ich laute Männerstimmen gehört habe. Ich konnte eine Zeit lang nicht mehr nach Hause zu meinen Eltern fahren und habe Weihnachten bei Freunden verbracht. Ich hatte Albträume, in denen ich wieder unter der Bettdecke liege. Mein Verhältnis zu meinem Vater ist noch schwieriger geworden, weil ich nicht mehr so tun kann, als wäre alles in Ordnung. Ich habe auch gemerkt, wie wenig ich das alles verarbeitet hatte.
Didn't smoke since, no other issues.
Ein paar Monate lang hatte ich Angst vor Herzproblemen und habe ständig meinen Puls kontrolliert. Ich war beim Kardiologen, alles in Ordnung. Inzwischen ist es fast weg.
